title: Canada reach World Cup Last 16 after Eustaquio stoppage-time winner
byline: Canada have reached the Round of 16 at the 2026 FIFA World Cup for the first time after a stoppage-time winner secured a 1–0 victory over South Africa.

title: Ireland seal historic T20 series win over India
byline: Hosts edge world champions by one run at Stormont to seal a memorable 2-0 series triumph.

title: West Indies beat Sri Lanka in first Test
byline: The West Indies produced a commanding all-round performance to defeat Sri Lanka by an innings and 217 runs in the first Test of the two-match series at the Sir Vivian Richards Stadium in Antigua on Sunday.

title: Over 18,000 Poson Dansals registered; PHIs step up inspections
byline: More than 18,000 Dansals have been registered across the country for the Poson Poya festival, with Public Health Inspectors (PHIs) intensifying inspections to ensure food safety and public health standards are maintained.

title: Venezuela quake death toll nears 1,500 as rescue work goes on
byline: Rescue teams raced on Sunday to find more survivors ​of the two powerful earthquakes that struck Venezuela this week, with signs of life bringing occasional relief to a grim quest to whittle down a list of tens of thousands missing.

title: Semi-Final Line-Up Confirmed in Women’s T20 World Cup 2026
byline: Australia, England, West Indies and South Africa are through to the final four after a 30-match group stage.

title: Strict action against liquor outlets violating Poson closure order
byline: The Excise Department has announced that strict legal action will be taken against licensed liquor outlets that fail to comply with closure orders imposed for the Poson Festival.

title: Girl visited her lover, gang raped by lover and his friends
byline: A young woman on a visit to meet her lover in Wilgamuwa town in Matale District had been gang raped by the lover and three of this friends at a house belonging to one of them. She was a resident of Kandy.

title: Argentine Footballer’s wife, kids killed in Venezuela earthquake
byline: In a devastating development, Venezuelan top-flight club Deportivo La Guaira has confirmed the tragic passing of Argentine defender Lucas Trejo’s wife and two children following the recent earthquakes in Venezuela. Trejo’s wife, Yanina Maranella, and their children, Aaron and Ainhoa Trejo, died when two powerful earthquakes struck the country’s Yaracuy region.

title: SriLankan Airlines cleared of wrongdoing in UAE payment cyber fraud
byline: SriLankan Airlines has been cleared of any wrongdoing in a payment made to a UAE-based service provider after investigations found that the funds had been successfully remitted and that the cyber attack had occurred on the recipient’s side, Deputy Minister of Ports and Aviation Janitha Kodituwakku said yesterday.

title: More arrests of lawyers, politicians and senior police officers
byline: More arrests of lawyers, politicians and senior police officers are likely in the near future with the further scrutinizing evidence over the alleged large-scale bribery network involving detained Nadun Chinthaka Wickramaratne, alias ’Harak Kata’.

title: Vacant lands becoming dumping grounds for garbage: Colombo Mayor
byline: While highlighting that there is a garbage collection issue in the city of Colombo, Mayor Vraie Cally Balthazar yesterday indicated that poorly maintained vacant lands are becoming dumping grounds and poorly segregated waste are main reasons for it.

title: Govt.’s proposal for Rs 100,000 fine against child labour triggers controversy
byline: The government’s move to dramatically increase the penalty for employing children has triggered public discussion, with a proposal to raise the fine from Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 100,000 now before Parliament.

title: Fumigation against dengue is ineffective, harms bees and dragonflies: Entomologists
byline: The Association of Health Entomologists has warned that mosquito fumigation alone is not an effective strategy to control dengue and could cause significant environmental damage by killing beneficial insects and contributing to insecticide resistance.

title: Hospitals reach full capacity as cases surge
byline: With Sri Lanka’s dengue outbreak reaching epidemic levels, patients are facing severe difficulties as hospitals in several parts of the country have reached full capacity to accommodate the growing number of dengue cases.

title: Mother drowns, daughter missing after falling into cultivation well in Galewela
byline: A 45-year-old woman drowned while her 10-year-old daughter remains missing after the two reportedly fell into a cultivation well near the Thubara Tank in Tennakonpura, within the Galewela Police Division.

title: Venezuela quake death toll nears 1,500 as rescue work goes on
byline: Rescue teams raced on Sunday to find more survivors ​of the two powerful earthquakes that struck Venezuela this week, with signs of life bringing occasional relief to a grim quest to whittle down a list of tens of thousands missing.

title: Dengue cases surpass 53,000 mark
byline: Sri Lanka has recorded more than 53,000 dengue cases so far this year, with health authorities warning of a significant spike in infections following increased rainfall during June.

title: Father and son rescued after four days buried under rubble of Venezuela’s earthquakes
byline: A father and his son were pulled out alive from the rubble of a collapsed building on Sunday, ​four days after the devastating earthquakes that struck Venezuela.

title: Pakistani strikes kill dozens in Afghanistan
byline: Pakistan launched airstrikes and sent ground troops into Afghan provinces along its border on Sunday, killing dozens.

title: Foreign passenger caught with Rs. 4.2 million worth of cigarettes at BIA
byline: A foreign national was intercepted by Sri Lanka Customs at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) while attempting to smuggle a large consignment of foreign cigarettes into the country.

title: True national development requires strong values and cultural identity: PM
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya says Sri Lanka’s national development cannot be measured solely by the growth of infrastructure and material resources, stressing that lasting progress depends on strengthening national identity, moral values, and cultural bonds.

title: Viral child-and-porcupine video shared as Bangladesh was filmed in Sri Lanka
byline: A fact-check by Stream found that the footage was actually filmed in Sri Lanka.

title: Let’s build a just and prosperous society based on love: Sajith
byline: All Sri Lankans must strive towards building a just and prosperous nation through love instead of hatred, Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa said in his special message for Poson.

title: Argentine Footballer’s wife, kids killed in Venezuela earthquake
byline: In a devastating development, Venezuelan top-flight club Deportivo La Guaira has confirmed the tragic passing of Argentine defender Lucas Trejo’s wife and two children following the recent earthquakes in Venezuela. Trejo’s wife, Yanina Maranella, and their children, Aaron and Ainhoa Trejo, died when two powerful earthquakes struck the country’s Yaracuy region.

title: Rev. Fr. Anton Ranjith appointed Bishop of Jaffna
byline: Pope Leo XIV has appointed Reverand Father Anton Ranjith Pilleynayagam as the new Bishop of Jaffna, the Vatican announced today.

title: ICC confirms qualification pathway for cricket’s LA28 Olympic return
byline: The ICC and the IOC have confirmed the qualification pathway for cricket’s return to the Olympic Games at Los Angeles 2028, with a new ICC Olympics Qualifier set to determine the final places in both the men’s and women’s T20 competitions.

title: Gold price has crashed nearly Rs 50,000 from its peak. Will prices fall further?
byline: Gold’s spectacular rally has gone into reverse. After touching an all-time intraday high of Rs 1,92,991 per 10 grams on the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX) earlier this year, the precious metal is now trading at around Rs 1,43,610, erasing nearly Rs 49,400 in value, a correction of about 26%.
